comments_data.body: Hello @lilitkarapetyan - can you explain how this fix works please?  Surely we don't have a database called `_global_changes`?

> Hello @lilitkarapetyan - can you explain how this fix works please? Surely we don't have a database called `_global_changes`?
The _global_changes" database is automatically generated by CouchDB by default. It's part of CouchDB's built-in functionality to track changes across all databases within the instance.
![Screenshot (284)](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/20753599/0c521cd7-95be-4214-b9c6-bb99802497c3)
it's just that its structure doesn't match the new messages we're receving, that's why we get an erro. 
![Uploading Screenshot (286).png…]()

I don't remember this feature. Can you remind me please @lilitkarapetyan ?

**Update**: sorry I missed the CouchDb part of the message. Got it.

I've updated it so that the updates from _global_changes aren't sent to tthe client through socket anymore
I think it is not necessary for us in the client section

issues.title: Get white screen when send feedback or send message and send message from admin
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
- Get white screen when send feedback or send message and send message from admin

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to https://serge-inet.herokuapp.com/
2. Create a basic game
3. Try to send feedback / send message from channel and send message from admin
4. Notice the white screen shows and user need to refresh page and login again

Note: this bug is not present when run on `develop`

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/d4ea0640-db78-4cf7-a7db-b0ff9a325d97)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
User can send message or send feedback without issue

## 🖥️ Screenscast

https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/b0c822e1-dbae-48e7-a841-d798a49a68d2



## 💻 System information
- Browser : Chrome
- Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111


## 📝 Additional context
